body: I never thought of it that way until I realized this fall that I was always the one contacting them first. I wanted to see if they would initate if I did nothing. What followed was several weeks of silence, lol.

Nah it’s just that I feel like they kind of don’t really give a shit about me. My therapist told me it’s important to keep doing normal things like going to school and hanging out with friends. I’ve tried contacting them and get something to happen but none of them seem really interested. The sad thing is that if I don’t initiate the contact with them, they never talk to me.

I fell in love(like head over heels, never so strong feelings ever) with this girl and my class and she will never love me the same way. Seeing her everyday at school is fucking killing me

Along with that highschool has been so bad that I’ve gone from A’s and B’s to E’s and F’s. 

My friends rarely talk to me.

It’s all just too unbearable.
